verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page offers an org-level opt-out from AI model training, arranged through the account manager. A community member's reading of the privacy statement confirms meeting data is used as anonymized training data by default, so whether data trains models is documented. The pack has no evidence of SOC 2 or HIPAA posture, and it does not show how the opt-out is technically enforced or verified. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA/BAA posture, documented enforcement mechanism for the training opt-out (it is only a contact-sales arrangement), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture

citations.quote: Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager to get started.
they understood that recordings are retained in the cloud and used, "anonymized," as training data
